prose_updates.tldr: An unpaired pilot identifies the two potential-outcome marginals but not their cross-world copula.  The note converts the sharp Fr\'echet covariance interval into an endpoint maximum for Zhao's affine residual-variance criterion, solves the regular rank-two problem with finite exact-input certificates, and treats Zhao's full all-rank pseudoinverse carrier through a measurable arbitrary-real selector and a separate exact-input cylindrical-algebraic selector.  A compact stable all-rank carrier makes observable deployment auditable: its regret relative to the unrestricted value is bounded by the exact stability price \(b_n^{\mathrm{st}}\), pilot error, optimization tolerance, and the selected-rank variance bridge.  The triangle witness proves an exact robust reduction of \(4912/39525\) in the basis objective and a positive observable variance gap for one displayed pair of tie representatives; no universal strictness or free stability is claimed.

project_justification.gap: Zhao's ex ante control-variate basis depends on a cross-world covariance that separate arm-specific pilot samples do not identify.  Existing sharp covariance bounds do not by themselves provide a globally certified basis optimizer, an all-rank pseudoinverse selector, or a bridge from the selected objective to the observable estimator under rank changes.
project_justification.niche: The experimental network, exposure maps, and assignment law are fixed and known, while two independent unpaired pilot samples identify exactly the two bounded marginal laws.  This separates design randomness from the ex ante dependence-robust basis decision and makes the unidentified copula the sole ambiguity in the endpoint objective.
project_justification.fill: The paper imports the sharp Fr\'echet covariance range, proves affine endpoint reduction, gives projective and rank-stratified certified optimization procedures, proves plug-in value and selector regret, and exposes a stable all-rank deployment carrier.  Its observable guarantee pays the explicit term \(b_n^{\mathrm{st}}=v_n^{\mathrm{st}}-v_{\mathrm{mm}}^+\) and a finite rank-adaptive bridge remainder rather than assuming singular-rank stability.

sampling_model.design: The main experiment uses a fixed finite network \(G\), known assignment law \(\nu\), known exposure maps \(f_i\), and two mutually exclusive exposure events.  Conditional on the selected basis and fixed potential-outcome array, the assignment \(W\sim\nu\) is the only design randomness.
sampling_model.units: The causal estimand is the fixed finite-population contrast \(\tau=n^{-1}\sum_i\{Y_i(1)-Y_i(0)\}\).  The law \(H^{\otimes n}\) is used only for ex ante basis-performance averaging and does not replace the design-based estimand by a superpopulation target.
sampling_model.treatment: Exposure is determined by the declared maps \(f_i(W)\); exposure positivity licenses inverse-probability weighting, and the known-exposure condition links the observed outcome to the appropriate exposure potential outcome.
sampling_model.overlap: Every \(\pi_{i,a}\) is positive.  The regular rank-two class requires \(\lambda_{\min}(n^{-1}S_B)\ge\kappa\); the stable all-rank carrier instead contains the exact rank-zero fallback and positive-rank strata with declared thresholds \(\lambda_{1,n}\) and \(\lambda_{2,n}\), together with the coordinate envelope \(\overline a\).
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The two arm-specific pilot samples are independent, unpaired, bounded draws from \(F_1\) and \(F_0\), and are independent of the main experiment.  Empirical means, variances, and quantile-coupling endpoints determine the plug-in endpoint matrices; no pilot pairing or copula estimator is used.

prose_updates.related_work: Zhao2026OptimalControlVariates supplies the network control-variate objective, the pseudoinverse convention, and the zero-covariance surrogate.  AronowGreenLee2014SharpVariance supplies the sharp Fr\'echet covariance endpoints and their attainment; Bergin1999RestrictedMarginals informs continuity of fixed-marginal coupling extrema.  AronowSamii2017 supplies the exposure-mapping design foundation.  Real-closed-field quantifier elimination and cylindrical algebraic decomposition supply exact finite certificates on algebraically encoded inputs, while the countable dense selectors used for arbitrary real pilots are explicitly nonconstructive and have no finite stopping test.  CaiDeJanvrySadoulet2015 and Zhao's reanalysis motivate the unexecuted Jiangxi PICC protocol, but authenticated replication data are not available and no numerical application result is asserted.
prose_updates.interpretation: The causal target remains \(\tau\); the quantities \(w^+(B)\), \(v_{\mathrm{mm}}^+\), and \(V_{\mathrm{st}}\) are respectively an ex ante worst-copula basis loss, its unrestricted design value, and the observable selected-basis performance.  Robust basis selection is therefore a design decision for estimating \(\tau\), not an identification formula for \(\tau\).  Rank-zero selection is exactly the uncontrolled Horvitz--Thompson fallback.  Positive-rank observable guarantees require certified spectral and coordinate stability, and the cost of imposing those restrictions is the visible, potentially nonzero quantity \(b_n^{\mathrm{st}}\).
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: The full pseudoinverse objective is discontinuous across uncontrolled rank changes, so arbitrary-real pilot optimization is supplied only as a classical measurable positive-tolerance selector.  Finite CAD certificates require rational or real-algebraic endpoint input.  The stable observable theorem assumes the entire displayed error sum, including \(b_n^{\mathrm{st}}\), is \(o(n^{-1})\) for its first-order conclusion; the design-rate assumptions alone control only the bridge remainder.  The exact triangle observable comparison concerns one displayed pair of tie representatives, and the Jiangxi PICC protocol remains heuristic, internally cross-fitted, and unexecuted.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The paper proves endpoint reduction, exact-input global certification, arbitrary-real measurable positive-tolerance selection, plug-in value regret, stable all-rank observable regret, and explicit triangle nonvacuity.  It does not claim a semidefinite-program reduction, a uniform complexity bound, a zero-tolerance arbitrary-real algorithm, universal full-carrier attainment, cross-rank outer-argmin convergence, point convergence under ties, universal strict improvement, or a zero rate for the stability price.  No Wald limit law is claimed; the delivered inference-side quantity is the finite ex ante expected conditional design-variance comparison for the displayed observable estimator.

statement_notes.justification: This lemma supplies the measurable arbitrary-real positive-tolerance rule on Zhao's full pseudoinverse carrier.
statement_notes.gap: The countable infimum and first qualifying index are set-theoretic objects and have no finite stopping test for arbitrary real pilot observations.
statement_notes.consumer: The unrestricted plug-in value theorem and objective-regret rate use this selector.

statement_notes.justification: Uniform endpoint-matrix convergence and the maximal-rank selector give full-carrier value consistency without assuming attainment across rank changes.
statement_notes.gap: The result concerns the basis objective and deliberately gives no singular-rank observable-estimator bridge.
statement_notes.consumer: The stable observable theorem uses its uniform full-carrier pilot modulus.

statement_notes.justification: The finite exact-input record certifies empirical near-optimality, selected rank, coordinate bounds, spectral margins, and an enclosure of the stability price.
statement_notes.gap: It applies only to exact rational or real-algebraic empirical and population endpoint inputs.
statement_notes.consumer: Exact-input stable deployments can audit every condition required by the rank-adaptive observable bridge.

statement_notes.justification: This theorem combines stable-carrier pilot regret with an eventwise rank-adaptive variance bridge to control the observable estimator relative to the unrestricted full-carrier value.
statement_notes.gap: Its first-order conclusion requires the full error sum to be \(o(n^{-1})\), including the exact stability price; no rate for that price is inferred.
statement_notes.consumer: It is the end-to-end design-performance guarantee for a deployable all-rank pilot-selected basis.

statement_notes.justification: The exact triangle enumeration shows that the certified machinery can produce a strictly positive observable robust-versus-surrogate variance gap.
statement_notes.gap: The witness is existential over one displayed pair of tie representatives and is not a universal tie-breaking or neighborhood result.
statement_notes.consumer: It supplies a finite lawful stress test for the observable deployment claim.
